text:
You're not getting rejected. You're boring her.

You sat across from her listing every reason she should like you.

Your job. Your loyalty. Your five year plan.

She smiled. Nodded. Then never texted back.

Because attraction isn't a debate. It's a feeling.

She doesn't pick the guy with the best argument. She picks the guy who makes her FEEL something.

Stop trying to convince her mind. Start moving her gut.

Win the argument, go home alone. Move her, she stays.
caption:
The dating psychology truth most men never hear: attraction isn't a debate you can win with logic.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
